modeSelect.seoTitle: SnapSpot Spot the Difference - Puzzle Garden
modeSelect.seoDescription: Compare two photos and find what's different. Play Normal or Arcade mode and test your eyes!
modeSelect.aboutBody: SnapSpot is a spot-the-difference game: compare two photos side by side and find every hidden difference. With 500+ stages and an Arcade time attack mode, it's a great way to sharpen your focus and eye for detail!

compare.label: Basics
compare.title: Compare two photos
compare.desc: Look at the original and the edited photo side by side and find what's different. Subtle changes in color, size or position are hiding in there.

tap.label: Controls
tap.title: Tap to check
tap.desc: Tap (or click) where you think the difference is to check it instantly. A correct tap leaves a marker.

zoom.label: Zoom
zoom.title: Pinch to zoom
zoom.desc: Can't see it? Pinch or scroll the mouse wheel to zoom in up to 3x.

stage.label: Stage
stage.title: Save your hearts
stage.desc: In Stage mode, every wrong tap costs a heart. Lose them all and it's game over, so tap carefully!

game.seoTitle: SnapSpot Spot the Difference - Puzzle Garden
game.seoDescription: Compare two photos and find the differences. Put your eyes to the test!
